# org: define milestones

Split the roadmap into understandable user-facing directions, so that tasks are tied to the outcome expected from a release.

The historical plan:

| Series | User-facing outcome |
| --- | --- |
| v0.1.x | Viewing and analysing the GitHub Contributions Calendar |
| v0.2.x | Managing GitHub labels |

The original checklist marked attaching the contribution issues to the v0.1.x milestone as done. The organizational criterion is that tasks have an agreed target release and that the milestone description explains what the user gets.

**Current state:** the issue is closed and reflects the former plan, not a current release guarantee. Labels were later removed by [#80](issue-80.md); preparing v0.1.0 and the historical v0.2.0 is described in [#30](issue-30.md) and [#16](issue-16.md). The local dump does not confirm today's milestone assignments on GitHub.
